|game_text=Deploy on Podrace Arena. Once per game, either player may initiate a Podrace: During opponent's control phase, each player may draw one race destiny. |strategy=By [mailto:jbh@spam.dimensional.com Joe Helfrich]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/boontaevepodraced.html</ref>

The [[Boonta Eve Podrace]] was the climax of the trip into Mos Espa. But this card, combined with the new Starting Interrupt Start Your Engines, makes podracing a nice side theme for almost any deck. Once the race is begun, both players compete, even if they don't have a podracer at the arena &#150; though having one certainly ups your chances.

Why wouldn't you start the race with the first turn? The race can be over in as little as 4 Dark Side turns with good draws, even faster if you've got a podracer at the arena. You may not have lost 6 force by then to retrieve, so you may be better off waiting a few turns. Also to make the most out of your podracing experience &#150; and to be sure you'll win &#150; you'll want to make sure that you have cards like [[Watto's Box]], and a handful of [[Sebulba]]'s dirty tricks like [[Pit Crews]] and [[Podracer Collision]] before you start.
